items.title: Papers: Poch to appoint Man Utd's first-ever female coach
items.description: The top stories and transfer rumours from Wednesday's newspapers...

items.title: Senegal and Morocco lead Afcon qualifiers but Tunisia protest
items.description: Senegal, Cameroon and Morocco qualify for the 2027 Africa Cup of Nations, but Nigeria are in trouble, and struggling Tunisia fail with an impassioned penalty protest.

items.title: Liverpool lead Chelsea in Camara race - Wednesday's gossip
items.description: Liverpool leading Chelsea in race for Monaco's Lamine Camara, Barcelona rule out moves for Virgil van Dijk and Bruno Fernandes, and ex-Crystal Palace winger Wilfried Zaha could rejoin the club.

items.title: The three teams England could face in the Nations League quarter-finals
items.description: England have topped their group in the Nations League after an incredible win over Spain - but who will they play in the last eight in March?

items.title: Highlights: Ten-man Portugal beat Wales to top group
items.description: Watch the best of the action as Portugal beat Wales in the Nations League in Cardiff.

items.title: Northern Ireland promoted to Nations League top tier with draw in Hungary
items.description: Justin Devenny's superb strike saw Northern Ireland earn promotion to the top tier of the Nations League with a hard-fought 1-1 draw away to closest challengers Hungary in Budapest.

items.title: Parrott fires Republic of Ireland into Nations League play-offs
items.description: Troy Parrott fired the Republic of Ireland into a Nations League play-off berth with two penalties in their 3-0 victory over 10-man Kosovo at the Aviva Stadium in Dublin.

items.title: Wales beaten by 10-man Portugal as Neto scores but is sent off
items.description: Wales ended their Nations League group campaign with a 3-2 defeat against 10-man Portugal in Cardiff after Chelsea's Pedro Neto was sent off.

items.title: Rangers great Brand dies aged 89
items.description: Rangers have paid tribute to Ralph Brand, one of the most prolific goalscorers in the club's history, who has died aged 89.

items.title: 'A great of the club' - Rangers legend Brand dies aged 89
items.description: Rangers have paid tribute to Ralph Brand, one of the most prolific goalscorers in the club's history, who has died aged 89.

items.title: Millwall open disciplinary proceedings against Baker
items.description: Millwall are undertaking disciplinary proceedings against forward Benicio Baker, BBC Sport understands.

items.title: Madrid-bound Gabriel posts farewell Man Utd message
items.description: TeenagerJJ Gabriel posts a farewell message saying Manchester United will always be part of his story, as he prepares for a likely move to Real Madrid.
